title: Draft canonical capability registry aligned to goal-state design
description: Draft the first canonical capability registry defining file shapes and behavioral contracts for the core Wheelwright object model. Includes canonical state model, track model, signal bulletin model, closeout receipt model, and migration receipt model per the canonical design document.

deliverables.canonical_track_model: Session tracking with mandatory architectural thinking capture
deliverables.migration_receipt_model: Idempotent capability adoption with rollback support
deliverables.behavioral_contracts: Clear what-this-does specifications for each model

implementation_guidance: Serves as practical implementation guide while respecting design principles of simplicity and small core object count
verification_status: Draft complete, aligned with canonical design document
